2. If defying the norms as per the Contract a legal action may be taken against me as per the existing Rules. 5. The items are to be supplied to BVY (Koc) as per purchase ordered raised by the BVY (Koc). 2. All rates are be quoted in Kgs and denomination for packing of items should be as mentioned at items n ame and declaration of the same should be furnished on bidder’s letter head. 3. All terms and conditions of GeM bid and additional documents uploaded is quality assurance documents be clearly read before quoting. Ink signed copy of duly filled additional documents and GeM bid to be uplo aded with technical documents. Any violation in terms and condition of additional documents and GeM bid documents by firm would results in disqualification of firm at technical stage. 4. The entire supplied quantity shall be packed in food-grade pouches of 1 Kg net weight each and pouche s shall be further packed in corrugated carton boxes containing 20 Kg(20 Nos x 1 Kg pouches) each for e nsure freshness, easy handling, storage and protection from moisture and contamination. The carton boxe s shall be strong properly sealed and capable of protecting the content from damage. 5. The supplier shall supply items conforming to the prescribed quality standards, free from insects, infestation, foreign matter and moisture beyond permissible limits. 6. Any packet found damaged, leaking, underweight or not conforming to the specified quality standards s hall be rejected and replaced by the supplier at no additional cost. 7. The name of the items net weight (1 Kg each), packing date, batch number and supplier details shall be clearly printed or affixed on each packet. 8. Delivery shall be made at the consignee’s location within the stipulated delivery period and in good con dition. 9. Two sample of each offered items shall be submitted by the bidder at consignee’s location prior to the o pening of bid. The submitted samples will be evaluated for quality, labeling and complianc with the tender specifications. Failure to submit the stipulated time may render the bid liable for rejection. 10. If the firm fails to honour any part of the purchase obligation, including but not limited to, failure to d eliver the stores/achieved milestones within the stipulated time for reason not attributable to force majeur e, the performance bank guarantee will be forfeitured in full as per discretion of the competent authority. .
